returned_sources.content:
Problem: Laptop connected to Wi-Fi but no internet access on macOS. It happens on my work laptop.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Restarted the network adapter and flushed the DNS cache.

returned_sources.title: DNS Cache Recovery - Guide 1
returned_sources.content: If Wi-Fi is connected but internet access is unavailable, open Command Prompt and run ipconfig /flushdns. Reconnect to Wi-Fi and test again.
